$comment: Documentation-only — Railway does not read per-service JSON files. This records the intended service configuration for the curation-worker Railway service: a cron one-shot that drains the curation queue and exits. It serves no HTTP and has no public domain.
manualTrigger: deploymentInstanceExecutionCreate (Run now) via dispatchCurationJob (admin dispatch, Slack refresh/rerun, refresh.ts --via-worker) — production only; never redeploy (a cron service redeploy does not run the job)
